description: This PHP source file defines the JobTitleAPI class within the OrangeHRM system's Admin API module. It implements CRUD operations for managing job titles, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting job title records. The class uses annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and integrates with related services, models, and DTOs to handle request validation, business logic, and response formatting.

classes.name: JobTitleAPI
classes.description: Defines REST endpoints for CRUD operations on JobTitle entities within the OrangeHRM admin module, including detailed request validation, file handling, and response generation.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the JobTitleService component used for business logic related to JobTitle entities.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single JobTitle by ID and returns it as a JobTitleModel object; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getOne' request, primarily ensuring the ID parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all job titles with optional filtering by 'activeOnly' and supports pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing job titles, including 'activeOnly' and sorting parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new JobTitle by processing input data, including optional job specification files.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Populates a JobTitle entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: setJobSpecification
methods.description: Assigns uploaded Base64-encoded attachment data to a JobSpecificationAttachment entity.

methods.name: getBase64JobSpecification
methods.description: Retrieves Base64 attachment data from the request payload.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Builds validation rules for creating a new JobTitle, including unique name constraints and optional fields.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules common to create and update operations for the main fields.

methods.name: getJobTitleCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Configures options for ensuring unique job title names, ignoring deleted records.

methods.name: getSpecificationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'specification' Base64 attachment input.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing JobTitle, handling optional specification and current job specification states.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Builds validation rules for updating a JobTitle, including skipping or replacing specifications based on request parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more JobTitle records based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation for deletion requests, primarily the list of IDs.
